findings.explanation: CH-U001-001 presents a universal, exceptionless causal guarantee. SRC-U001-CLAIM-001 and SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001 support only a possible platform-level claim and mechanism, while SRC-U001-ATOMIC-015 expressly disallows guaranteed outcomes unless explicitly grounded. The prose therefore exceeds PLAN-U001's mechanistic ceiling.

assessments.rationale: The underlying convenience-and-attention claim is supported by SRC-U001-CLAIM-001 and its mechanism by SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001, so the target is partially supported. CH-U001-001 states the claim as fact and requires no hypothetical framing under PLAN-U001, but its universal guarantee violates the claim-strength limit and the explicit prohibition in SRC-U001-ATOMIC-015. No named specificity appears.
